Combines deep Oracle expertise across fusion cloud, e-business suite, financials, HCM, payroll, and procurement with strong governance, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, risk management, and test leadership. Recognised for bringing structure to complex programmes, resolving delivery challenges, and driving successful outcomes across global and geographically distributed organisations.
